pages.text: Use the $(l)Kitty Work Clipboard$() to configure your worker cats:$(br2)1. $(l)Right-Click Cat$(): Select cat.$(br)2. $(l)Sneak + Right-Click Cat$(): Cycle job (Farmer, Lumberjack, Miner, Rancher, Courier, Sorter, Fisher, Collector, Gunsmith).$(br)3. $(l)Right-Click Work Station$(): Bind cat to station.$(br)4. $(l)Sneak + Right-Click Block$(): Set Work Area Corners A & B.

pages.title: Kitty Habitat 2.0
pages.text: Right-Click a $(l)Kitty Habitat$() with a selected cat on your Clipboard to house the cat inside the habitat safely.$(br2)Sneak + Right-Click the Habitat with the Clipboard (or break the block) to release your cat back into the world. Optional Forge Energy (FE) doubles production speed!
